headline: UMI led coverage with a 30.51% rise on 2.31x volume, while alert-driven weakness was concentrated in PROP and CONS.
market_take: Coverage was led by UMI, which rose 30.51% on 2.31x volume and also showed a +28.81% open gap. PROP had the broadest downside cluster, including PF and EVER at -20.00%, while CONMAT was mixed with EPG at -8.40%, DCON at +7.14% and UMI sharply higher. There were 38 unusual-trading alerts, including 14 high-severity alerts, so liquidity and event risk warrant attention.

sector_notes.note: UMI was the standout, gaining 30.51% on 2.31x volume with a +28.81% open-gap alert. DCON added 7.14%, while EPG fell 8.40% on 2.24x volume.
PF and EVER each fell 20.00%, with EVER also flagged for a -20.00% intraday move. CGD fell 10.00% on minimal 0.02x volume, and ANAN declined 5.71%.
PLE fell 16.67% and carried a matching intraday-move alert. EMC had the most extreme alerts, including a -50.00% open gap and a +100.00% intraday move.
Activity was down overall, with NRF down 4.55% and OKJ down 4.14%. ICHI and CPI triggered volume-spike alerts of 5.9σ and 10.5σ versus the 20D average, respectively.
TU-PF fell 4.63% on 1.92x volume. QHOP and SSPF posted volume-spike alerts of 3.4σ and 4.8σ versus the 20D average.
